title: Rann Utsav 2026-27: Dates, Tent City, White Rann Permit and How to Reach Dhordo
seoTitle: Rann Utsav 2026-27: Dates, Full Moons, Permit & Stays
seoDescription: Rann Utsav 2026-27 runs 1 Nov 2026 to 7 Mar 2027 at Dhordo. Full-moon dates, the ₹100 White Rann permit, tent city tariffs and how to reach from Bhuj.
excerpt: Exact purnima times for the season, how the separate White Rann permit works at Bhirandiyara, the tent city's published per-person tariffs, and when a Bhuj or village stay makes more sense.
